# ThreddIQ — Reddit SaaS Pain Point Miner & Market Intelligence Engine

> ThreddIQ is an AI-powered SaaS market intelligence platform built with Next.js App Router, Postgres/Drizzle ORM, and advanced LLM semantic extraction pipelines. It monitors 100k+ subreddits, extracts verified customer frustrations and willingness-to-pay budget signals, clusters them into structured pain pillars, and delivers actionable opportunity scores for SaaS founders and product teams.

Use this file as the navigation index for understanding product architecture, public routing matrix, API surfaces, database models, and AI mining pipelines.

## Public Marketing & Content Matrix

- [Landing Page](app/page.tsx): Main marketing page with interactive demo, value proposition, and pricing.
- [Blog Index](app/blog/page.tsx): Research studies, teardowns, and SaaS idea validation guides.
- [Documentation Center](app/docs/page.tsx): Developer documentation, API guides, and scoring mechanics.
- [Case Studies](app/case-studies/page.tsx): Founder teardowns and validated revenue case studies.
- [Pre-Mined Niches Directory](app/niches/page.tsx): Pre-computed Reddit opportunity reports across high-demand verticals.
- [Free Tools Hub](app/free-tools/page.tsx): Lightweight public utilities for quick pain point scoring.
- [Resources Directory](app/resources/page.tsx): Curated subreddit guides and industry monitoring playbooks.
- [Dynamic XML Sitemap](app/sitemap.ts): Search engine index covering all public marketing, niche, and content URLs.
- [Robots Directives](app/robots.ts): Crawl instructions protecting private dashboard segments while indexing public content.

## Product Features & Modules

- [AI Pain Point Mining](app/features/pain-point-mining): Semantic clustering of 1,000+ rants into root causes.
- [SaaS Idea Validation](app/features/idea-validation): Upvote-weighted demand signals and opportunity scoring.
- [Market Discovery](app/features/market-discovery): Problem density mapping across 100k+ subreddits.
- [Keyword Monitoring](app/features/keyword-monitoring): Real-time keyword alerts and competitor mention tracking.
- [Sentiment Analysis](app/features/sentiment-analysis): Emotional intensity, budget signals, and desperation index scoring.

## Core API Surface

- [Mining Search API](app/api/search/route.ts): Main search/mining orchestration endpoint.
- [Scheduled Batch API](app/api/search/scheduled/route.ts): Background batch scheduler trigger endpoint for recurring scans.
- [Live Stream API](app/api/search/stream/route.ts): Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time mining progress and results.
- [Dynamic OpenGraph API](app/api/og/route.tsx): Edge-rendered dynamic social share images (1200x630).
- [Search Status API](app/api/search/status/route.ts): Mining run status and progress verification endpoint.
- [Subreddit Suggestions](app/api/search/suggest-subreddits/route.ts): Intelligent subreddit recommendations by keyword/vertical.
- [Reports API](app/api/reports/route.ts): Report persistence and retrieval endpoints.
- [Settings API](app/api/settings/route.ts): User workspace preferences and webhook configuration.
- [Billing Entitlements API](app/api/billing/entitlements/route.ts): Stripe subscription entitlement checks.

## AI & Data Extraction Pipeline

- [Mining Runner](lib/mining-runner.ts): Reddit ingestion orchestration and async worker pipeline.
- [Reddit Client](lib/reddit.ts): Reddit API integration, rate limiting, and normalization.
- [AI Engine](lib/ai.ts): Multi-model LLM extraction prompts and structured JSON parsing.
- [Vector Embeddings](lib/embeddings.ts): Semantic embeddings generation for topic grouping.
- [Clustering Logic](lib/clustering.ts): Unsupervised clustering of related pain points and opportunities.
- [Trend Scoring](lib/trend-detection.ts): Upvote velocity, mention volume, and desperation signal aggregation.
- [Pre-Mined Niches Dataset](lib/premined-niches.ts): Static database of high-opportunity SaaS niches.

## Persistence & Data Schema

- [Drizzle Schema](lib/db/schema.ts): PostgreSQL tables for users, workspaces, scans, opportunities, and subscriptions.
- [Database Client](lib/db/index.ts): Connection pooling and query builders.
- [Drizzle Config](drizzle.config.ts): Migration scripts and schema generation settings.

## Operations & Quality

- [Next.js Config](next.config.ts): App configuration and security headers.
- [TypeScript Config](tsconfig.json): Strict type definitions.
- [Vitest Config](vitest.config.ts): Unit and integration test suites.
- [ESLint Config](eslint.config.mjs): Strict quality and formatting rules.
